[[Illyana's Staff]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[staff]] dropped by [[The Darkness (boss)|The Darkness]]es, [[boss]]es who can be found in [[The Hall of Heroes (explorable area)|The Hall of Heroes]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +15
:[[Chaos damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Domination Magic]])
:Halves casting time of [[spell]]s (Chance: 10%)
:Halves skill recharge of [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Shadow Staff]].
